Article 7 (Cooperation with Relevant Agencies, etc.)
(1) Where necessary for investigations or research concerning rehabilitation and bankruptcy proceedings, the Committee may commission relevant experts, agencies or organizations to conduct such investigations or research.
(2) Where necessary, the Committee may have relevant public officials or experts attend its meetings and hear their opinions, and may request opinions, submission of materials and other cooperation from relevant national agencies, research institutes, organizations or experts.
